Question: Are AI-proposed QA actions reviewed by a named human before acceptance?
Is there a kill switch, and are AI agent accesses revocable on request?
Is the identity of each AI agent logged on decisions affecting customers?
Are agent permissions reviewed at stated intervals (at least quarterly)?
Is there a complete inventory of AI providers in use?
Do supplier contracts prohibit training on customer data?
Do AI escalations go only to an authorised supervisor?
Is a named person accountable for AI-assisted decisions?
How is the accepted-versus-edited rate of AI QA monitored?
Are staff trained on responsible AI and prompt safety?
Are AI incidents notified within the contractual SLA?
Are prompts and outputs logged with PII retention rules applied?
